COVER_FOOT: Fifteen a side · Two halves · Every rule
MENU_QUICK_DESC: Pick two counties and a ground. Play now.
MENU_CHAMP_DESC: Groups, then knock-out games to the final.
MENU_WATCH_DESC: Sit back: two counties, played by the computer.
MENU_HOWTO_DESC: The rules, the controls and the officials' signals.
MENU_FOOT: No real players or competitions: counties by their place names, every hurler invented.
LENGTH_NOTE: How long a match takes you. At 35 minutes the clock runs at about the real pace while the ball is in play: a full 70-minute match, and a real match's score.
GRADE_NOTE: Senior county hurling has halves of 35 minutes, and the black card for denying a goal chance. Club games have halves of 30 and no black card.
DIFF_JUNIOR_DESC: They give you time on the ball, and miss more often.
DIFF_SENIOR_DESC: Quicker to the ball, harder in the tackle, sharper in front of the posts.
DIFF_ALLSTAR_DESC: The best there is: every chance taken.
ASSIST_OFF_NOTE: Everything is yours: four steps with the sliotar in your hand, then you must solo, pass or strike, or it is a free against you.
ASSIST_SOLO_NOTE: Your player puts the sliotar on his hurley himself before his fourth step. You still strike, pass and catch. He runs to meet a pass to him till you move him.
ASSIST_FULL_NOTE: As Solo, and with your thumb off the joystick your player runs for the loose ball himself.
GFX_AUTO: Lower it by itself if a match runs slowly
GFX_NOTE: Low suits phones with 2-4 GB of memory: simpler players, fewer people in the stands, no outlines, a smaller picture. The game picks one for your phone the first time it runs.
GFX_LOWERED: The match was running slowly: graphics lowered a step (Settings).
FPS_NOTE_SAVER: About {n} frames a second and a slightly smaller picture: cooler and longer on the battery.
FPS_NOTE_SMOOTH: {n} frames a second on your {hz} Hz screen: smooth, and kind to the battery.
FPS_NOTE_MAX: As many as your {hz} Hz screen shows. Smoothest, uses the most battery.
MOVE_BUTTONS_NOTE: Drag each button to where your thumb wants it. The game keeps them there. Reset puts them back.
ABOUT_DISCLAIMER: Hurling Heroes is not connected with, or endorsed by, any sporting body, county board or club. The counties appear by their place names in colours of the game's own design; every player is invented. No data leaves your phone.
LICENCES_INTRO: Hurling Heroes is made with the Godot Engine and the fonts below. Their licences ask that these notices be shown.
EXTRA_TIME_NOTE: A winner is needed: two halves of ten minutes' extra time, then penalties if it is still level.
NO_GOAL_HAND: A goal cannot be scored with the hand: puck-out.
CALL_DISSENT: Dissent: the free moves on 30 metres
SIN_BIN_LINE: {name}: ten minutes in the sin bin
CHAMP_PICK_NOTE: The ten strongest counties play the Summer Championship; the next ten the Tier Two Cup. Two groups of five, then knock-out hurling.
CHAMP_WON: Your county are the champions. The cup goes home with them.
CHAMP_OVER: The championship is over for another year.
CHAMP_OUT: Your county are out. The championship goes on without them.
CHAMP_TABLE_NOTE_1: Two points a win, one a draw, then score difference. The top two meet in the group final; its winner goes to a semi-final, its loser to a quarter-final against the other group's third.
CHAMP_TABLE_NOTE_2: Two points a win, one a draw, then score difference. The top two of each group go to the semi-finals.
KNOCKOUT_NOTE: A knock-out game: a draw goes to extra time, then penalties.
RULES_AIM_TEXT: Two sides of fifteen, each with a hurley (the camán), strike the sliotar, a small leather ball, at the other side's goal: H-shaped posts 6.5 metres apart with a crossbar 2.5 metres up and a net under it.
RULES_SCORE_TEXT: Under the crossbar is a goal, worth three points; over it, between the posts, a point. The score is written goals-points: 2-18 is 24, and beats 0-23.
RULES_TEAM_TEXT: A goalkeeper; three full-backs; three half-backs; two midfielders; three half-forwards; three full-forwards. Each defender marks the forward facing him. Five substitutes, and three more in extra time.
RULES_TIME_TEXT: Two halves of 35 minutes in senior county hurling, 30 in club games, with time added on for stoppages. The referee keeps the time, and starts each half by throwing the sliotar in between the four midfielders.
RULES_CARRY_TEXT: You may take four steps with the sliotar in your hand. Then you must put it on your hurley (a solo) and may take it back into your hand once more. After the second catch you must play it away. On the hurley you may carry it as far as you like.
RULES_HANDPASS_TEXT: You may pass it with your hand, struck away with a definite striking action, never thrown. A point may be scored with a hand-pass, a goal may not.
RULES_GROUND_TEXT: You may not pick the sliotar off the ground with your hand: lift it with the hurley (a roll lift or a jab lift), or strike it on the ground first time.
RULES_TACKLE_TEXT: A fair challenge: a side-to-side shoulder, hooking or blocking the striker's hurley, flicking the sliotar off a player's hurley or out of his hand.
RULES_FOULS_TEXT: Pulling a man down, tripping, holding, pushing, charging from behind, a careless hurley, striking a player's hurley when he is not playing the ball: a free to the other side, where it happened.
RULES_CARDS_TEXT: A yellow card is a caution; a second is a red, and he is sent off and not replaced. In senior county hurling, pulling down, tripping or a careless hurley that denies a goal chance inside the 20 m line or the arc is a black card (ten minutes in the sin bin) and a penalty.
RULES_PUCKOUT_TEXT: After a score or a wide, the goalkeeper strikes the sliotar out from the small rectangle. Everyone else stands outside the 20 m line until it is struck, and it must travel 13 metres before one of his own side plays it.
RULES_FREE_TEXT: Taken where the foul was: lifted with the hurley and struck, opponents 13 metres away. A foul by a defender inside his 20 m line gives a free from the 20 m line; in the large rectangle a technical foul gives a free from its centre.
RULES_65_TEXT: When a defender puts the ball over his own end line wide of the posts, the attackers strike a free from the 65 m line opposite where it crossed.
RULES_SIDELINE_TEXT: Over the sideline, the other side strike it back in from where it crossed, off the ground, with opponents 13 metres back.
RULES_PENALTY_TEXT: For an aggressive foul by a defender in his large rectangle, or a foul that denies a goal chance. Struck from the 20 m line, one defender on the goal line, everyone else outside the 20 m line and the arc.
RULES_DRAW_TEXT: In a knock-out game a draw goes to two halves of ten minutes' extra time. Still level: five penalties each, only goals count, then sudden death.
RULES_HELMET_TEXT: Every hurler wears a helmet with a face guard: the rule at every grade since 2010.
CTRL_MOVE_TEXT: Your thumb anywhere on the left of the screen is a joystick. Your player has the gold ring.
CTRL_SWITCH_TEXT: The small SWITCH button changes your player to the teammate best placed for the ball. When the ball is struck to a teammate you become him.
CTRL_STRIKE_TEXT: STRIKE with the joystick toward the posts (or let go of it) is a shot for a point. Pushed elsewhere, it is a long ball to the teammate that way.
CTRL_GOAL_TEXT: Inside about 30 metres GOAL drives it low at the net, away from the goalkeeper.
CTRL_PASS_TEXT: PASS hand-passes to the teammate the joystick points at (a short strike if he is further, or the sliotar is on your hurley).
CTRL_SOLO_TEXT: SOLO puts the sliotar from your hand onto your hurley before your four steps are up (the dots over your player count them). HAND takes it back, your second catch.
CTRL_CATCH_TEXT: When the sliotar comes near: CATCH it in the air, or LIFT it off the ground with the hurley.
CTRL_PULL_TEXT: PULL strikes a loose ball first time, on the ground or in the air, without taking it.
CTRL_TACKLE_TEXT: Near the man on the ball: TACKLE (a shoulder, a hook or a flick, as the moment needs); BLOCK when he goes to strike. From behind, or too late, it is a free.
CTRL_RESTART_TEXT: Your puck-out: LONG (aim with the joystick) or SHORT to a back. Your free, 65 or sideline: STRIKE at the posts or PASS to a teammate. A penalty: aim, then GOAL.
CTRL_ASSIST_TEXT: Settings > Help with the ball: Off, Solo (he solos before his fourth step) or Full (he runs for loose balls too).
CTRL_KEYS_TEXT: WASD or the arrows to run; Space, J, K and L for the buttons; Q to switch; Esc to pause.
SIG_POINT_TEXT: The umpire waves the white flag.
SIG_GOAL_TEXT: The umpire waves the green flag.
SIG_WIDE_TEXT: The umpire crosses his arms over his head.
SIG_65_TEXT: The umpire raises an arm straight up, then points in at the 65 m line.
SIG_FREE_TEXT: The referee's whistle, then his arm held out toward the goal the free attacks.
SIG_ADVANTAGE_TEXT: One arm held straight up for up to five seconds: play on. If nothing comes of it, he brings it back for the free.
SIG_CARDS_TEXT: He holds the card up to the player; for the black card, then ten fingers for the ten minutes in the sin bin.
SIG_SIDELINE_TEXT: The linesman holds his flag out the way the cut goes.
COACH_INTRO: Drag on the left to run. The buttons on the right come up as you need them. Over the bar is a point; in the net, a goal (3).
COACH_MOVE: Drag your thumb on the left to run. You are the man with the gold ring.
COACH_LOOSE: The sliotar is near: CATCH it in the air or LIFT it off the ground. PULL strikes it first time.
COACH_IN_HAND: In your hand you may take four steps (the dots count them). SOLO puts it on your hurley.
COACH_ON_STICK: On the hurley, run as far as you like. STRIKE for the posts or PASS to a teammate.
COACH_SHOOT: In range: push the joystick toward the posts and STRIKE. Over the bar is a point.
COACH_GOAL: Close in: GOAL drives it at the net, worth three points. STRIKE over the bar for one.
COACH_TACKLE: He has the ball: TACKLE from the side or the front. From behind, it is a free to them.
COACH_SWITCH: The ball is far from you: SWITCH takes the teammate best placed for it.
COACH_FOLLOW: Lost the sliotar? A white dot marks it, and off the screen an arrow at the edge points to it.
COACH_PUCK_OUT: Your puck-out: LONG down the field (aim with the joystick) or SHORT to a back.
COACH_FREE: Your free: STRIKE for the posts or PASS to a teammate. Wait, and it is taken for you.
COACH_PENALTY: A penalty: aim with the joystick, then GOAL. Only the goalkeeper stands in your way.
COACH_STEPS: Too many steps: a free to them. SOLO it onto your hurley before the fourth step.
SET_COACH_NOTE: Short tips through a match, each the first time it is needed. On for your first match.
SUBS_PICK: Tap a tired man, then the one to bring on. The change is made at the next break in play.
SUBS_DUE: {on} on for {off} at the next break
TAC_SWEEPER_NOTE: A half-forward (12) drops back in front of the full-back line and marks no one: an extra man in defence, one fewer up front.
TAC_TWO_FF_NOTE: The corner-forward (13) comes out to the half-forward line, and his marker with him: two left inside with room to run.
TAC_PUCKOUT_NOTE: Short to a free back keeps the ball but invites the press; long into the middle is won about half the time.
CALL_SWEEPER: {team} drop a sweeper back to hold the lead
CHAMP_BYE: {team} had a bye: the round's other games have been played (Results).
